objective: Explore a crypto cross-sectional strategy through bounded beam search. Compare network-known factor families, handcrafted factors, and AlphaGPT-style symbolic formula variants. Each branch must end as a compact one-task session with distillable facts, failures, hypotheses, and next directions.

directions.title: Search known factor ideas
directions.objective: Collect known crypto cross-sectional factor families from public/network memory and convert them into concrete factor definitions plus deterministic evaluation plans. Do not backtest manually unless a monitor/script exists.

directions.title: Handcraft factor hypotheses
directions.objective: Generate first-principles crypto cross-sectional factor hypotheses: momentum, reversal, liquidity, volatility, funding/basis, market microstructure, and exchange-flow proxies. For each factor, specify exact inputs, formula, lagging rules, and validation monitors.

directions.title: AlphaGPT-style symbolic formulas
directions.objective: Explore formulaic alpha expression templates using operators such as rank, ts_rank, decay, zscore, neutralize, correlation, delta, and rolling aggregation. Propose bounded formula search seeds and write follow-up child directions to beam.children.json if needed.
